list.name: Human
list.physiqueTemplate: Human build, average height. NPCs treat you as ordinary — you blend in easily.

list.name: Elf
list.physiqueTemplate: Tall and slender, pointed ears, almond eyes. Your voice is melodic. NPCs sense ancient patience.

list.name: Dwarf
list.physiqueTemplate: Stocky, broad-shouldered, ~4 feet. You look UP at most NPCs. Your voice is a low rumble. Braided beard (if male).

list.name: Halfling
list.physiqueTemplate: Small, ~3 feet. You must reach UP for tavern tables. NPCs lean down to hear you. Curly hair, bare feet.

list.name: Gnome
list.physiqueTemplate: Small, ~3 feet. Wild hair, bright eyes. NPCs often underestimate you. Your voice is quick and sharp.

list.name: Half-Elf
list.physiqueTemplate: Tall, graceful, subtly pointed ears. Neither elves nor humans fully accept you.

list.name: Half-Orc
list.physiqueTemplate: Towering 6'6"+, tusks, scarred. NPCs step back. You duck doorways. Your voice is guttural.

list.name: Tiefling
list.physiqueTemplate: Horns, tail, unusual skin. NPCs recoil or make signs. Merchants refuse service. Your voice carries a subtle echo.

list.name: Dragonborn
list.physiqueTemplate: Scaled, tall, draconic. NPCs are wary. Your voice rumbles like distant thunder.

list.name: Drow
list.physiqueTemplate: Ebony skin, white hair. Surface-dwellers distrust you openly. You squint in sunlight.

list.name: Githyanki
list.physiqueTemplate: Tall, gaunt, yellow-green skin, sharp eyes the colour of old bronze. NPCs sense an alien stillness — the kind that carries silver swords and flies on red dragons in dreams.
